name: ALGOL 68RS
reason: The anchor foregrounds the ported compiler and also links the FLEX system under a written-in language description. TN802 §§1–2 and the 1978 manual keep the compiler and accepted variant distinct. The original 1979 FLEX report No. 79016 §1.2 names an RS Algol 68 compiler and §6.1 uses RS Algol 68 for the language used to write its kernel. The lead’s entire chain therefore bears both readings. The compiler-specific identity and implementation relation remain supported.
